Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original VFX art-direction storyboard for the AcademyCraft Minecraft mod, a concept proposal, NOT a real game screenshot. 1536x1024 landscape sheet, carefully organized 3D voxel game graphics, coherent camera and lighting. Readable restrained Chinese typography.
Visual language inspired by the fictional Dark Matter ability: opaque white otherworldly substance with continuous irregular skin-like thin lamellae, long tapered slits, shallow light-grey undersides, a few very fine straight white strands. White substance can smoothly form arbitrary surfaces. Use daylight, minimal bloom, clear material edges and depth; target voxel model remains recognizable. NO bird feather outlines, central quills, barbs, wings, glowing magic circles, runes, blue electric sparks, colored healing crosses, clouds of glitter, cinematic fog or soft-focus. No gore, no missing limbs, no detailed human anatomy, no real meshes dissolving on living targets. Strong white versus charcoal contrast. Subtle natural shadows, not glossy crystal, not metallic armor, not cotton or paper confetti.
Layout: compact header, one wide hero scene across the upper 55%, three equal close-up phase panels across bottom 35%. Only the specified title, concept disclaimer, and numbered captions. Clean dark-charcoal gutters and unobtrusive labels. Close-ups must show causal, continuous progression with identical subject pose and view.
Title text exactly: "未元物质 · 分解"
Small subtitle text exactly: "概念演示 · 非实机"
Hero scene: Minecraft daylight grassy testing ground, a standard blocky dark-clothed caster standing on the left with one arm forward. To the right, a normal blocky grey training humanoid, standing intact. Clearly visible white transformation only on a small region of the target's upper torso and shoulder, about one-quarter of torso area: narrow jagged white fingers spread over the surface into a connected patch, a few parts of this white surface lift outward 2 to 6 centimeters as narrow curved strips, separating into a sparse trail of small elongated fragments. Asymmetric growth, 4 to 8 major strips at most; root of each strip remains anchored to adjacent white material. Target stays fully solid and present underneath; no visible chunks cut out of target. The white lamellae need visible thickness and shadowed reverse edges. Sparse released fragments travel a short distance outward and vanish, never a large radial explosion. The important aspect is connected surface becoming layers before particles.
Bottom three panels: matched tight shoulder close-up of same grey voxel target:
1 "01 白质侵入": several sharp hairline white seams spread into a small connected opaque white patch along the surface, model entirely intact.
2 "02 片层剥离": same patch forms 5 narrow irregular smooth white lamellae which curl and lift slightly away from surface; there are fine elongated gaps between layers; shallow grey undersides make depth.
3 "03 离析消散": the few lifted layers become tiny white fragments just outside shoulder, most white overlay already gone, fully intact grey model showing again underneath.
Focus on small readable repeatable real-time effect, not a large magical transformation. The intact geometry in every stage is mandatory.

Focus effect only on part of their right forearm and a very small nearby chest region, not a whole glowing suit. A few narrow opaque white strands run along the blocky surface and meet across shallow dark seams in a TEMPORARY white overlay. They smoothly broaden into 3 to 5 connected thin white lamellae that fuse into one local continuous surface, then flatten flush to the undamaged underlying sleeve and fade to reveal its original charcoal pixel texture. 1 "01 白质接入": 3 or 4 very thin tapered white strips start growing on the sleeve edges toward the middle, with exposed original charcoal sleeve between them, nothing punctured.
2 "02 相向接合": strips grow toward each other and connect into a continuous SMALL white surface across the sleeve, with narrow grey seams just closing, not separate scales.
3 "03 压平退白": most white surface has flattened and receded revealing original charcoal sleeve texture; only two thin white traces remain disappearing at edges, body entirely unchanged.

Keep total temporary white coverage smaller than one-third of the visible arm. Communicate restore through connected white material flattening and disappearing, no green light.

inspection.disassemble: Read all Chinese captions; white connected layers lift outward; surviving voxel body remains intact. Close-ups exaggerate edge detail for art direction, not a promise of exact shader detail.
inspection.repair: Read all Chinese captions; attached white strands join into a local membrane and recede; limb remains intact. Arm is a generic schematic surface proxy, not a newly added repairable slot.
